<!-- pr-reviewer: 6f03721cca0774260c353710fecf1a937d547b43 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one small, non-code fix; the behaviour review is clean).

**What looks good**
- Old `settings()` vs new `settings_page`/`groups`/`actions`/`readout`, side by side: every control dispatches the same command with the same arguments under the same conditions. `ActivateSetup(Some(name))` only when the radio is clicked and the setup is not active; `CreateSetup { name: None, datum_from: None }` only in the no-setups branch; `DeleteSetup(name)`; Open fixtures still calls `browser_pane::focus` then `actions::target(SetupNode(name, Fixtures))`. Delete and Open fixtures keep their captions, now as an `even_row` (index 0 is Delete, anything else is Open).
- The undisclosed-pinned rows are byte-equivalent: `setup_axis_pick::rows` (Primary / Apply axes / Clear axes), `setup_plane_pick::row`, `setup_points_pick::row`, `setup_align_pick`, `setup_relative_pick`, `setup_wcs_pick`, `wcs_pick_row::row` are untouched files and are called with the same `(ui, state, name)`. Only their enclosing group differs. Their dispatch is therefore unchanged. The only observable difference is that they now sit inside a collapsible group (see note 1).
- `shown()` is the exact old guard, De Morgan'd: old `held.is_none() && !turns` returned early, so it drew when `held.is_some() || turns`; `shown` is `turns || held.is_some()`. It cannot hide a control that used to show; `row()` re-reads `held` after the check, same value.
- Layering ok (ui only calls `camcraft_app` and existing seams), no new component, no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, provenance line present, new files 123 / 268 lines, `setup_pages.rs` shrank to 209. No PNG, `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts, dependency or process-file change. Decision file present. `Refs #1440` is right for a series slice.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, clean auto-merge)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=1` (CWD `crates/ui`): 690 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored. The one failure is the known `diag::tests::shared_ui_code_prints_only_through_the_diag_seam` (#1475, `egui_app/app_icon.rs:25`, not this PR).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings`: clean.
- All 8 `setup_settings_page` pins green.
- Mutation sample, applied alone to `setup_settings_page.rs`, each went red: Delete dispatch dropped (`the_setup_actions_still_queue_their_commands`), workholding group always drawn (`a_lathe_setup_draws_the_workholding_group` + group-order test), `wcs_pick_row` call dropped, `setup_axis_pick::rows` call dropped (both caught by the group/armed tests).

**Requested before merge**
1. `docs/decisions/1440-setup-page-tidy.md` (the "groups' body indent" bullet) says the indent is "2 px instead of egui's 18"; the code (`setup_settings_page.rs`, `INDENT = 12.0`, `ITEM_GAP = 4.0`) and the PR body say 12 and 4. Please correct the decision entry so the ledger matches what shipped.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Every control of the page is now inside a `layout::group`, which is collapsible. Collapsing "Part orientation" hides the armed plane/points/axis rows until it is reopened; before this PR they could not be hidden. Same behaviour as the sibling slices (WCS page), so consistent, but worth knowing. Open state is keyed by group title only, so it is shared across setups.
2. Order inside "Work offset" changed: old page drew `wcs_pick_row` ("Set WCS from features") before the G54-G59 picker; new page draws the picker first. Harmless, and the PR text describes the new order.
3. Primary / Apply axes / Clear axes remain unpinned for armed state, as disclosed; I confirmed by reading that their call and arguments are unchanged.
4. Tiny: `pane_w` clamps with `.max(24.0)` and `cell_w` again `.max(24.0)`; fine, just redundant.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
(Duplicate of the review just above, posted twice by mistake. See pullrequestreview-5895834015.)
